feed.title: NPR Topics: Climate
feed.subtitle: In-depth coverage of climate change, weather events, climate science, emissions targets and adaptation strategies from NPR’s climate reporters.

entry.title: These deer walk 300 miles a year. The race is on to save their migration
entry.summary: Mule deer in Wyoming make some of the longest land migrations in the lower 48 states. They're trying to adapt to a changing climate, but growing development could stand in their way.

entry.title: COP31 ends with no deal after negotiators fail to reach an agreement on fossil fuels
entry.summary: International climate talks in Turkey ended in disappointment with countries failing to reach agreement over fossil fuels -- the primary driver of climate change.

entry.title: Climate policy analyst on the failed negotiations at COP31
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with climate policy analyst Alden Meyer about why negotiators at COP31 failed to reach an agreement.

entry.title: Climate change talks fall apart in final hours over fossil fuels
entry.summary: Some 200 countries gathered in Antalya, Turkey, for COP31, the annual climate negotiations. Countries failed to reach an agreement over fossil fuels - the primary driver of global warming.

entry.title: Deadlocked again? U.N. climate talks in Turkey go into overtime
entry.summary: United Nations climate talks are heading into super overtime this weekend in Turkey. Negotiations were supposed to wrap up Friday but talks have spilled into a second night.

entry.title: Storms expected on both coasts threaten Thanksgiving travel
entry.summary: The mayor of San Francisco is asking people in the city not to travel unless "absolutely essential." Meanwhile, a storm moving up the Eastern seaboard could also cause travel delays ahead of Thanksgiving.

entry.title: This year's U.N. climate conference was bigger than ever—but did it make progress?
entry.summary: This year's U.N. climate conference was bigger than ever. But that doesn't necessarily mean there was progress.

entry.title: Climate talks are now in overtime
entry.summary: Delegates from nearly 200 countries have been meeting for two weeks to discuss steps to limit global warming.

entry.title: Rising seas have forced this Quinault village to relocate
entry.summary: The Quinault Indian Nation has moved its largest village away from rising seas and tsunamis

entry.title: Trump's impact on an Ohio steel plant
entry.summary: The giant steel plant in Middletown, Ohio planned to switch away from using coke, a refined form of coal. The switch would have cut hazardous air pollution -- and greenhouse gas emissions. But that plan has changed under President Trump
